messages:
jamie: Quick sync — postmortem INC-712 action items. Can folks confirm ownership + firm due dates? Pasting current list (from doc):

```
1) Rollback/runbook -> sara (proposed EOD Thu 2024-11-07)
2) Canary deployment scripts -> michael (needs infra change)
3) Model fallback tuning -> leo (requires dedicated capacity)
4) Postmortem write + tracking -> jamie (will publish changes)
5) Product acceptance criteria -> tanvi (blocks release)
```

jamie: Please shout if any of these should move or need extra deps. @channel

sara: I can own the rollback/runbook. EOD Thu works. I'll drop a runbook snippet in the doc and open a PR for review :thumbsup:

michael: I'll take the canary scripts. Blocked on eng-infra kernel bump (they need to enable continuous-batcher). Pinged eng-infra separately. Tentative due Mon 2024-11-11 if infra is green.

tanvi: For product acceptance I need staging perf numbers + regression test results. Targeting 11/12 after QA. If canary proves stable earlier, can move up.

leo: I'll own model fallback tuning. Need a one-day slot on Dedicated capacity to run stress tests — can ops schedule? Also will add tuned params to model-ops PR.

jamie: I'll update the postmortem tracker link: <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-712|INC-712 postmortem>. Please add PR links there. Also, let's record concrete due dates in the doc. I'll mark current owners as tentative until they confirm here.

incident-bot: Action items updated on tracker INC-712 by jamie. 5 actions; owners: jamie, sara, michael, leo, tanvi.

michael: FYI — eng-infra bump request posted in the eng-infra channel (thread 1760000001).

sara: I'll draft rollback runbook now. Plan: `rollback -> scale-to-zero -> switch-route -> confirm smoke`. I'll paste the exact steps in the doc in a few hours.

jamie: Thanks. If everyone confirms by EOD today I'll set these as the official owners and add due dates in Tracker. Otherwise I'll follow up tomorrow morning. :v:
